title: Teaching Assistant (Level 3) – Compass Room Lead
description:
As a Level 3 Teaching Assistant (Compass Room Lead), you will play a key role in supporting teaching staff and working collaboratively with the wider Inclusion, SEND and Pastoral teams to enhance the development, wellbeing and educational outcomes of students with additional needs.

You will lead the day-to-day operation of Compass, providing a structured, supportive environment for students who require additional regulation, guidance, relational support or targeted intervention to engage successfully with school life and learning. Compass is a needs-led provision that aims to remove barriers to learning while maintaining students' participation in mainstream education wherever appropriate.

Your responsibilities will include supporting students through induction, assessment, intervention and ongoing review processes, helping to identify barriers to learning and implementing strategies that promote engagement, independence and positive outcomes. You will contribute to the planning, delivery and evaluation of targeted support programmes for individuals and small groups, monitoring progress and reporting on outcomes to teaching and pastoral staff.

You will work closely with the Achievement Support Team, SENDCo and wider Inclusion Team to ensure support is tailored to individual student needs and reviewed regularly. The role also includes promoting positive attendance, supporting successful reintegration into lessons where required, and contributing to the school's inclusive approach to SEND provision.

In addition, you will deliver targeted enrichment and intervention activities during break, lunchtime or after school as part of the Achievement Support programme.

This role involves working alongside an experienced Inclusion Team while also providing guidance and support to Level 1 and Level 2 Teaching Assistants.

For this position, you will either have previous experience as a Level 3 Teaching Assistant or substantial experience as a Level 2 Teaching Assistant and be ready to take the next step in your career.

This is an exciting and rewarding opportunity for someone who is proactive, resilient and passionate about helping young people overcome barriers, develop independence and succeed both academically and personally.

description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Manager, Sales Development - EMEA

Location: Remote UK

Compensation Range: £47,250 base with on target earnings at £63,000 plus equity

What You'll Do:

Huntress is looking for a talented and passionate Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help fuel our continued growth. In this role, you will open doors for the Account Executive team by building relationships with managed service providers (MSPs) and managed security service providers (MSSPs), earning trust quickly, and turning early conversations into qualified meetings that move the pipeline forward. You are outcome-obsessed in how you work, with a clear eye on the right next step, the right partner fit, and the follow-through it takes to create real pipeline impact.

In the daily rhythm of prospecting into the MSP and MSSP space, you bring warrior spirit. You stay steady through rejection, keep your standards high, and come back sharper on the next call. You also give a sh*t about the people on the other end of the phone, leading with honesty, curiosity, and respect as you help prospective partners understand the value Huntress can deliver to their business and their customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish rapport and trust with managed service provider (MSP) and managed security service provider (MSSP) prospects via phone, email, and LinkedIn to understand their business and their fit with Huntress.
  • Set qualified meetings within our ideal customer profile by following best practices and standard processes.
  • Generate and qualify net-new accounts and work inbound opportunities to create a pipeline for the Account Executive team.
  • Use clear, value-driven messaging to build interest in Huntress and answer prospect questions with honesty, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Research accounts, document prospecting activity, and qualification notes in CRM, and maintain strong data hygiene.
  • Use AI tools with good judgment to support account research, call prep, and message drafting in your day-to-day work.
  • Keep improving your cold calling, messaging, and pipeline management skills through training, feedback, and repetition.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • 8+ months of experience in a quota-carrying outbound B2B SaaS sales role.
  • Experience with outbound cold calling.
  • Strong time management and the ability to prioritize competing tasks.
  • Comfort working across CRM, prospecting tools, and multiple systems at the same time.
  • Attention to detail when taking notes, setting meetings, and following the process.
  • A coachable mindset and a genuine interest in continuing to grow your sales and cybersecurity knowledge.
  • Curiosity about AI and the judgment to use it in practical ways that help you work faster and smarter in your day-to-day.

  • New starter home office set up reimbursement (£398)

title: Senior Financial Crime Analyst
description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London/Cardiff/UK Remote | £59,500 - £80,500 + Benefits ✨| ℹ️ 12 Month Fixed-Term Contract

Our Financial Crime team ⭐

Our Financial Crime Collective helps keep Monzo and our customers safe by building effective, proportionate controls that protect against financial crime while delivering great customer outcomes.

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Crime Analyst to join our Actions Squad. You’ll be a subject matter expert across key financial crime controls, taking ownership of complex problems and helping us continuously improve how our controls operate across both Monzo Bank Limited (MBL) and Monzo Bank Europe (MBEU).

This is a role with plenty of ownership and cross-functional exposure. You’ll work closely with teams across Financial Crime, Operations, Product and Engineering, using data and your financial crime expertise to identify risks, strengthen controls and shape longer-term improvements.

You’ll play a key role by...

  • Owning our global risk controls for Exit & Defunds, Law Enforcement and Acceptable Use Standard, with end-to-end oversight of BAU performance across MBL and MBEU.
  • Developing and improving control documentation and standards, balancing financial crime risk, operational efficiency and customer experience.
  • Using data and trend analysis to monitor control effectiveness, identify emerging threats and spot opportunities to strengthen our controls.
  • Making sure we have appropriate financial crime control coverage as Monzo launches new products and expands into new areas.
  • Identifying and prioritising material risks, escalating these clearly to leadership alongside practical, evidence-based recommendations.
  • Owning the investigation and remediation of incidents within your control areas and partnering with other Control Owners to resolve high-impact issues.
  • Acting as a domain expert for your areas, providing technical guidance, sharing knowledge and helping build capability across the wider Financial Crime Collective.
  • Leading cross-functional initiatives across Product, Operations and Engineering, building shared understanding and influencing teams towards compliant and customer-focused solutions.
  • Taking on Nominated Approver and Financial Crime Floater responsibilities.

We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have strong financial crime and regulatory compliance expertise and are comfortable acting as a subject matter expert within your domain.
  • You’re confident using data to understand control performance, identify weaknesses and make evidence-based recommendations — experience with tools such as Looker would be useful.
  • You’re comfortable independently assessing and prioritising complex financial crime risks, making proportionate decisions and escalating material issues when needed.
  • You communicate clearly and can adapt your approach for different audiences, from operational and technical teams through to senior leaders.
  • You’re great at working cross-functionally and can build strong relationships across teams such as Product, Operations and Engineering to influence outcomes without relying on formal authority.
  • You’re comfortable managing a complex portfolio and competing priorities, while maintaining a high bar for quality and proactively identifying opportunities to improve how we work.


What’s in it for you

£59,500 - £80,500

ℹ️ Please note this will be a 12 month fixed-term-contract

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.


The application journey has 3 steps...

  • 20 min call with the recruiter
  • Intro call with the Hiring Manager
  • 2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.

As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.

We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and develop multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, supporting their growth and impact.
  • Own and drive the technical strategy for a critical platform domain, aligning it with broader company and platform goals.
  • Enable teams across Spotify to build product experiences efficiently by improving the underlying catalog systems.
  • Guide the evolution and modernization of complex legacy systems into scalable, reliable architecture.
  • Partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders to align priorities and drive execution.
  • Improve system reliability and reduce operational friction in workflows that directly impact content availability.
  • Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI to improve data quality and engineering productivity.
  • Build an inclusive engineering culture where teams continuously improve how they work and deliver.
  • Develop and execute a long-term roadmap that balances immediate priorities with strategic investments.

Who You Are

  • You have experience leading engineering organizations through other leaders and scaling teams effectively.
  • You have worked on complex, data-intensive systems where accuracy, consistency, and reliability at scale are critical.
  • You bring strong system design and architectural decision-making experience in distributed systems.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and making thoughtful trade-offs in high-impact environments.
  • You have experience evolving legacy systems and guiding long-term platform transformations.
  • You influence effectively across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
  • You have experience leading distributed teams and creating alignment across locations.
  • You communicate clearly and can explain complex technical topics to a range of audiences.
  • You are curious about how AI and automation can improve systems and workflows and apply that thinking pragmatically.
  • You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where teams can grow and do their best work.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
We are delighted to invite applications for the role of Specialist Instructor at Liberty Academy. This is a full-time, permanent position and an exciting opportunity for an ambitious and passionate person.

You will complement the professional work of teachers by taking responsibility for agreed learning activities under an agreed system of supervision, consistent with the aims of the school. Activities involve planning, preparing and delivering learning lessons in the specialist subject across all key stages, as well as monitoring pupils, assessing, recording and reporting on pupils achievement, progress and development.

You will work within the classroom or appropriate area of the school site delivering lessons on Construction.

Liberty Academy is a welcoming, inclusive school at the heart of the Hull community, where every child is known, valued, and supported to achieve their potential. We place a strong emphasis on safeguarding, wellbeing, and positive relationships, ensuring pupils feel safe, supported, and motivated to attend school every day.

Liberty Academy offers a positive working environment, strong leadership support, and the opportunity to have a meaningful impact on young people’s futures within a school that genuinely cares about its community.

Liberty Academy is a large 11-16 secondary school in Hull with a strong sense of community and a high level of commitment. We are a team that believes that we can achieve anything together.

We are seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking candidate who can teach Construction to students and is committed to delivering high-quality, engaging lessons.

At Liberty, we value creativity and encourage new approaches to teaching and learning. Our curriculum is designed to broaden students’ horizons and enhance their cultural capital. Assessment is centrally planned to ensure consistency and to support a manageable workload, allowing staff to focus on what matters most, excellent teaching.

Our Technology Construction Specialist Instructor will provide students with engaging, practical opportunities to develop valuable skills for life, further education, and future careers. Working across the secondary school, they deliver hands-on learning in technology and construction, encouraging students to develop their creativity, problem-solving abilities, confidence, and technical skills. Through practical projects, students are supported to explore construction techniques, use tools and materials safely, and understand the importance of teamwork, precision, and resilience.

What we can offer:

  • Experienced and supportive School Leadership Team

  • Opportunities for staff to develop through Continuous Professional Development

  • Local Government Pension scheme

  • Occupational Health

  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Free on site parking

Job Details

Hours of Work: 37 Hours per Week, Term Time Only (including training days)

Position Type: Permanent

Line Manager: Director of Learning Technology

Travel Required: No

The salary is dependent on current qualifications and experience, please see the attached job description for more information

You should use the information supplied with in the Job Description & Person Specification to make the best of your application by identifying some specific pieces of work you may have undertaken in any of these areas. title: Finance Business Partner
description:
About the Role

Salary: L1-L6 (£47,347-£55,796 FTE)

Full-time or part-time would be considered on 4 days per week.

This is a CELT Shared Services position that will be based at Poltair School, St Austell.

Are you an experienced finance professional looking for an opportunity to use your financial expertise to make a real difference in education?

Cornwall Education Learning Trust (CELT) is seeking a proactive, analytical and commercially minded Finance Business Partner to join our team and provide high-quality financial management, strategic support and professional advice across a number of our schools.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in partnership with Headteachers, Directors of Phase and senior leaders, helping to shape financial strategy, support effective decision-making and ensure resources are used efficiently to deliver the best possible educational outcomes for our learners.

What will you be doing?

As a Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting the financial sustainability and strategic development of our schools. Working closely with the Trust Finance Lead and Chief Financial Officer (CFO), your responsibilities will include:

  • Financial planning and strategy: Leading financial planning for allocated schools, supporting the annual budget cycle and developing accurate multi-year forecasts and scenario models to inform strategic decisions.

  • Financial management and reporting: Preparing monthly budget monitoring reports, analysing financial performance and providing clear, timely financial information to school leaders, executive leaders and Trustees.

  • Strategic business partnering: Building strong, trusted relationships with Headteachers, Directors of Phase, Finance Officers and other key colleagues, translating complex financial information into meaningful insights and practical recommendations.

  • Financial sustainability: Advising leaders on staffing structures, pupil numbers, funding changes and other financial considerations, ensuring budgets align with educational priorities and long-term plans.

  • Compliance and governance: Supporting statutory financial reporting, audit processes and compliance with the Academy Trust Handbook, Funding Agreements and internal financial policies.

  • Systems and continuous improvement: Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting tools and internal controls, promoting efficiency and consistency across the Trust.

  • Leadership and development: Supporting and line managing allocated finance staff, encouraging collaboration, accountability, professional development and a positive team culture.

You will also contribute to financial training and guidance across the Trust, helping colleagues strengthen their financial understanding and make informed, effective decisions.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a confident and collaborative finance professional who can combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

You will be comfortable analysing complex financial information, developing forecasts and financial models, and presenting clear advice to colleagues who may not have a finance background. With a high level of Excel proficiency, excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines, you will bring a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

You will hold an AAT/CCAB Level 4 qualification or above, have at least five GCSEs including English and Maths at grade C or equivalent, and have experience working within a finance function or accountancy practice. Experience operating financial systems and presenting complex financial information to non-financial audiences is essential.

Experience within an educational setting, producing management accounts and complex financial forecasts, or managing junior staff would be advantageous. Knowledge of school-based accounting systems, the Academy Trust Handbook and education sector funding would also be beneficial.

Above all, you will share our commitment to using resources responsibly and effectively to support our schools, colleagues and learners.

Why join Cornwall Education Learning Trust?

At CELT, our mission is to provide every learner with an exceptional educational experience. Our family of 16 schools educates approximately 9,000 learners across mid-Cornwall, supported by a collaborative community of around 1,200 colleagues.

Joining CELT means becoming part of a values-driven organisation where collaboration, innovation and care for people are at the heart of everything we do.

We are committed to empowering our people and creating opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our staff entitlement includes:

  • Professional development: Access to training, mentoring, networking and opportunities to develop your skills and career.

  • Health and wellbeing: Access to health screenings, discounted gym and leisure memberships, mental health support and a confidential employee assistance helpline.

  • Family and flexibility: Family-friendly policies, flexible working arrangements and up to five days of paid emergency leave for dependants.

  • Financial benefits: A generous public sector pension scheme and access to the Cycle to Work scheme.

You will have the opportunity to contribute to the long-term success of our schools, influence strategic financial decisions and work alongside colleagues who are passionate about making a difference to the communities we serve.

Ready to make a difference?

If you are a skilled finance professional who enjoys building relationships, providing strategic advice and helping organisations make the most of their resources, we would love to hear from you.

Join Cornwall Education Learning Trust as our next Finance Business Partner and help us ensure that effective financial planning supports exceptional educational experiences for every learner.

To find out more about the role or arrange a discussion, please contact our Recruitment Team at recruitment@celtrust.org.

title: Apprenticeship Assessor - Hairdressing and Barbering (Variable Hours)
location: Leeds, Yorkshire and the Humber, GB
description:
About the Role

Harrogate College is looking for a dedicated Hairdressing and Barbering Apprenticeship Assessor to join our Apprenticeships department. In this role, you will deliver training both on and off-site, work closely with local employers to provide tailored training solutions. You will establish Individual Learning Plans (ILPs) with clear milestones, monitor progress, conduct formal progress reviews at least every 12 weeks, and track vocational achievements using e-portfolio systems like OneFile. Additionally, you will support the recruitment and onboarding of new apprentices, participate in quality assurance practice, and deliver constructive feedback to ensure high learner retention and timely completion.

  • Plan & Review: Build tailored Individual Learning Plans (ILPs) with clear milestones, conduct formal tripartite progress reviews with apprentices and employers at least every 12 weeks, and ensure off-the-job training commitments are fulfilled.

  • Onboard & Collaborate: Work alongside the recruitment team to recruit, enroll, and sign up new apprentices, perform employer health and safety checks, and foster strong relationships with local salon partners.

  • Maintain Quality: Participate in internal quality assurance (IQA) procedures, uphold safeguarding and PREVENT standards, and actively drive learner retention and timely achievement targets.

About You

  • Qualifications: Level 3 Hairdressing/Barbering qualification, Assessor Award (e.g., CAVA, TAQA, A1), and Level 2 English & Maths (IQA or teaching qualification desirable).

  • Industry & Assessment Experience: Proven background in current salon practices, carrying out workplace assessments, and managing learner portfolios.

  • Employer Relationship Management: Strong track record of networking, building partnerships, and collaborating with local salon employers.

  • Teaching & Autonomy: Ability to plan and deliver practical/theoretical training independently with minimal supervision.

  • Learner Support & Target Focus: Capability to motivate a diverse range of apprentices to hit key completion deadlines and drive retention.

  • Compliance & Values: Commitment to safeguarding, PREVENT, equality and diversity, and high professional standards.

About The Role

At Avanti Fields, a safe, clean and well-maintained school environment is essential to creating the best possible experience for our students, staff and visitors. Working closely with the School Principal, Business Support Manager, Area Site Manager and wider premises team, you will help ensure that resources are used effectively and that the school's operational needs are met.   • Set up rooms, furniture and equipment for scheduled activities, meetings and school events, including open evenings and weekend events as required.
  • Monitor the school car park at designated intervals, ensuring that parking is restricted to authorised users in accordance with the school's procedures.
  • Open and close the school premises as required, ensuring buildings are secure, access arrangements are managed appropriately, and all necessary equipment and facilities are switched on or off in accordance with school procedures.

What are we looking for?

  • Good communication skills; written and verbal.
  • NVQ Level 2 or equivalent in Numeracy and Literacy.
  • General knowledge of building maintenance procedures and relevant skills
  • Understanding of Health and Safety and security issues.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Good organisational skills- ability to meet deadlines and make decisions in emergencies.

title: KMAT Head of Estates & Facilities
description:
Head of Estates & Facilities

Kenilworth Multi Academy Trust

Band Q

Permanent

This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled estates professional to lead a dedicated team, oversee health and safety compliance, manage contractor performance, support capital and maintenance projects, and ensure our schools provide safe, secure and inspiring environments for pupils and staff. The successful candidate will work closely with Headteachers, the CEO and CFO to deliver effective estates management across the Trust.

Kenilworth Multi Academy Trust is a growing and ambitious Trust committed to providing outstanding educational environments in which our pupils and staff can thrive.

We are seeking to appoint an experienced, motivated and highly organised Head of Estates and Facilities to lead and develop all aspects of estates, facilities and health and safety management across our Trust.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will have responsibility for the management of Trust premises, ensuring our schools remain safe, compliant, secure and well maintained. You will provide strategic leadership for estates operations whilst also supporting the day-to-day management of facilities services across multiple sites.

The Role

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and managing estates, site and facilities teams across the Trust.
  • Ensuring compliance with all statutory health and safety requirements.
  • Managing contractor performance and procurement processes.
  • Chairing Health and Safety Committees and providing professional advice to school leaders.
  • Leading on risk assessment processes, emergency planning and business continuity arrangements.
  • Overseeing premises security, statutory inspections and maintenance programmes.
  • Managing compliance areas including fire safety, legionella control, contractor management and premises risk management.
  • Supporting capital works, improvement projects and planned maintenance initiatives.
  • Leading on sustainability, energy efficiency and biodiversity initiatives across the Trust.
  • Developing effective systems for asset management and maintenance tracking.

About You

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has significant experience in estates, facilities, premises or property management.
  • Has a strong understanding of health and safety legislation and compliance requirements.
  • Has experience of managing contractors, external service providers and operational budgets.
  • Has experience of leading teams and coordinating resources across multiple sites.
  • Is confident in advising senior leaders and presenting reports to stakeholders.
  • Possesses excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrates a proactive, solution-focused approach with the ability to respond effectively to operational challenges.
  • Shares our commitment to safeguarding and supporting young people.
Desirable Qualifications and Experience

We would particularly welcome applications from candidates holding qualifications such as:

  • NEBOSH General Certificate.
  • IOSH Managing Safely.
  • Facilities or Estates Management qualifications.
  • Specialist training relating to fire safety, legionella management, asbestos awareness, COSHH or premises compliance.

Experience within the education sector, academy trusts, local authorities or other public sector organisations would be advantageous.

Why Join KMAT?

This is an excellent opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping and maintaining the Trust's estate strategy, ensuring that our schools continue to provide outstanding learning environments for pupils and staff.

You will join a collaborative and supportive Trust team committed to excellence, continuous improvement and delivering the very best outcomes for our communities.

  • Excellent CPD opportunities

  • A supportive team of colleagues within the Department and across the school

  • A positive, community school environment

    A dedicated and forward-looking management team, with highly skilled staff upholding high expectations and aspirations for our students

    Employee well-being benefits via our healthcare programme to include health diagnostics, physiotherapy, 24/7 GP and mental health support, retail and gym discounts, free flu vaccination, free parking and at Keniworth site access to electric car charging and use of an on-site fitness suite

    LGPS pension scheme

Flexible Working

The postholder will be required to work across Trust sites and, on occasion, undertake evening, weekend or out-of-hours work to meet operational requirements.

We reserve the right to close this advert early and invite candidates to interview before the closing date should we receive a sufficient number of applications, or a suitable candidate be found. We will be reviewing applications as they are received, therefore early applications are advised and welcomed.

title: Senior Commercial Counsel - Flex Coverage Across EMEA
description:
Legal | Remote, UK | Remote, Remote



Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

This is a remote position, as part of a distributed team. To help our teams work together effectively we're looking for someone based in the UK.

Senior Commercial Counsel

We're looking for a talented commercial transactions attorney to join our team to support our commercial business in EMEA with flexibility to support across different GEOs in EMEA. In this role, you will work with the sales team, internal business partners, and other Legal team members to review and respond to requests from current and prospective customers.

As a valued member of this team, you will further grow your already existing hands-on experience drafting and negotiating a variety of customer and partner agreements and while performing matrix management across cross-functional teams. You will have the chance to contribute to team projects and contribute to our positive remote team culture. This is an excellent opportunity for experienced professionals looking to further develop their skills and become a member of the extended Go-to-Market team, while supporting strategic transactions for Atlassian (a publicly-traded Software company (NASDAQ: TEAM) with over 13,000 employees, recognized on the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For list for six consecutive years).

Your future team

Atlassian's Legal Team is seen within Atlassian as an impactful business partner, serving our business with practical and business-oriented advice and solutions. Our team is highly collaborative and supportive - we love working with each other and are generous in cheering on our teammates successes.

You will report directly to the Senior Director, Head of Commercial Legal EMEA Region. Within that team, your focus will be to support transactions across different countries in EMEA. We'll determine a more focussed scope as you onboard. You will have lots of opportunity to work closely with other colleagues in EMEA and globally, both on the day job and on project work.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Be an active part of our Commercial Legal Team, which supports Atlassian's enterprise sales business.
  • Negotiate enterprise cloud and license agreements for Atlassian's products and services, including master services agreements.
  • Work in a tech forward legal team with a strong focus on AI implementation across all our workstreams
  • Partner and collaborate with other teams, such as sales, deal desk, partner & alliances, privacy, risk and compliance, security, finance, accounting, and product teams to facilitate contract reviews and internal process improvement, and development and enhancement of our customer-facing forms.
  • Providing pragmatic, business-minded guidance on contract-related issues.
  • Developing support materials and providing trainings to educate our direct sales and channel teams on contract terms and other legal issues.
  • Build trusted relationships with our sales colleagues in the region, being extremely curious about our company's business priorities and proactive in suggesting solutions.
  • Advise business and corporate functions in the region in close collaboration with our specialist teams in the US and EMEA.
  • Contribute to projects improving contract processes and sales enablement.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

About you:

  • You like to work in a team and build relationships with sales teams and have a track record doing so.
  • You take ownership and accomplish tasks seeking appropriate support.
  • You bring empathy and understanding to your conversations with customers and clients, creating a path forward that balances company risk and customer needs.
  • You enjoy negotiating and closing deals in a collaborative spirit, and you don't use a rigid approach.
  • You are not afraid to say "I don't know" and you ask many questions.
  • You enjoy working remotely and you enjoy taking up new responsibilities and work both autonomously as well as collaboratively in a multicultural team.
  • You think creatively beyond the "legal" box to offer solutions for the business.
  • You are curious and enthusiastic about AI: working with AI tooling, and following legal developments regarding AI and AI product features.

On your first day, we'll expect you to:

  • Full Netherlands, French, German, Spanish, Italian, or UK law degree (LLB/LLM) and ideally a formal bar qualification or equivalent professional registry with 8+ years PQE.
  • Have strong experience handling b2b contract negotiations and have good commercial, tech, and business acumen, particularly in SaaS and tech.
  • Be fluent in English, other languages are a plus.
  • Be curious about Atlassian's products, culture, and business model.
  • Be enthusiastic to work in an international environment, learn and take on new responsibilities.
  • Have good knowledge of privacy matters, including GDPR.
  • Have experience in the cloud space and tech contracting.

We appreciate as a plus:

  • Additional legal qualifications in other EMEA jurisdictions, particularly Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden, France, Italy or Spain.
  • Knowledge/experience in other legal areas.
  • Experience with public sector customers (public procurement) and financial institutions (FSI)

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit

title: Data product manager
description:
Aristocrat has a reputation for groundbreaking strategies in the gaming industry. As a Data Product Manager, you will play a leading role in advancing innovation and quality in our iLottery division. This important role lets you merge business needs with data capabilities to produce world-class solutions. We cultivate collaboration, inclusion, and strong ambition at Aristocrat, making this a highly outstanding chance for driven individuals to make a tangible impact. Join us in crafting the future of regulated online gaming using your expertise and passion!

What You'll Do

  • Partner with lottery customers and internal collaborators to deeply understand their business objectives, processes, decisions, and difficulties.
  • Translate business needs into scalable, trusted, and actionable data solutions by assessing relevant sources, definitions, quality, constraints, and platform capabilities.
  • Own initiatives throughout the entire product lifecycle, from opportunity assessment through development, delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
  • Define reusable data products, including governed datasets, semantic models, dashboards, APIs, data feeds, monitoring and alerting capabilities, and self-service features.
  • Collaborate with engineering and governance teams to establish data contracts, quality rules, lineage, metadata, ownership, access controls, retention, and monitoring.
  • Maintain and prioritize the backlog using customer value, business impact, risk, dependencies, effort, and capacity.
  • Coordinate delivery across Data Engineering, BI, QA, Architecture, and platform teams, ensuring clear communication of scope, decisions, risks, and timelines.
  • Serve as a key product contact for data and reporting needs, facilitating alignment across customers, collaborators, and delivery teams.
  • Work with support and engineering teams to define observability, incident priorities, root-cause follow-up, and preventive improvements for production data products.

What We're Looking For

  • Over 2 years of experience as a Product Manager/Owner of a data product, managing data & analytics solutions (Data Lake/DWH/ Cloud Service).
  • Experience in the iGaming or iLottery industry is highly beneficial.
  • Proficiency in data modeling, infrastructure, and analytics.
  • Experience working with data pipelines, ELT workflows, and contemporary cloud data architectures.
  • Experience with current cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL, dbt, Airflow, or similar tools.
  • Ability to understand and work with SQL queries and data models.
  • Knowledge of data governance, privacy, security, regulatory reporting, and responsible data use cases.
  • Excellent communication and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with BI reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik or similar platforms.
  • Agile Product Management experience: Features/User Stories, Acceptance Criteria and Agile Delivery.
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira, Trello, TFS/Azure DevOps Server, Monday.com.
  • BA/B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Economics, Information Systems, Computer Science/Engineering, Information Technology, or another quantitative field.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, data products, or machine learning concepts is an advantage.

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 About the Role:
 The Regional Principal Analyst is the most senior technical individual contributor within a Falcon Complete region, serving as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and their immediate leadership teams. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across multiple fireteams, supporting on complex incident response, conducting deep technical case review, identifying operations and product improvement opportunities, and driving technical quality across regional operations through various technical deliverables. The Regional Principal Analyst maintains deep, current expertise through regular hands-on engagement, and collaboration in complex service delivery scenarios.

 What You'll Do:
 Technical Leadership:
 • Serve as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership Team on all Falcon Complete service delivery matters
• Ensure technical consistency, quality standards, and best practices across regional operations
• Lead regional technical initiatives
• Coordinate with other Regional Principals to ensure global consistency and knowledge sharing

 Technical Escalation Support:
 • Serve as a technical escalation resource for Fireteam Principal Analysts on complex or ambiguous cases, providing second opinion, additional analysis, and technical guidance, while assisting with Principal technical development
• Fireteam Principal Analysts retain ownership and lead of high-severity incident response; the Regional Principal supports as a technical resource, and highlights opportunities to improve the Falcon Complete service and technical excellence of the region.
• Perform independent technical analysis when asked to validate or extend a fireteam's findings

 Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance:
 • Conduct technical QA reviews of closed cases across fireteams against defined criteria with documented findings
• Identify detection gaps, false-positive patterns, and coverage opportunities from regional case data; route findings to relevant teams as improvement requests
• Identify opportunities for tooling, telemetry, or workflow improvements based on recurring case patterns
• Identify regional trends in detection patterns, threat landscape, and case quality
• Identify skill gaps and development opportunities across the regional analyst population
• Drive adoption of consistent operational standards and agentic toolsets across regional operations.

 Cross-Functional Technical Liaison
 • Represent regional technical perspective in cross-functional initiatives with other CrowdStrike business units
• Work directly with Product/Engineering to surface detection coverage gaps, platform bugs, and feature requests
• Coordinate with OverWatch and Intelligence on regional threat trends
• Partner with other Regional Principal Analysts on shared technical review standards and case QA criteria
• Partner with Watchtower to drive detection tuning and coverage improvements based on regional intelligence.

 Thought Leadership & Market Engagement
 • Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, conference presentations, and other speaking events as appropriate

 Strategic Projects & Innovation
 • Provide Technical expertise on regional projects that align with Falcon Complete mission and corporate goals
• Drive innovation in detection gaps, triage, remediation, and automation capabilities
• Collaborate with Section 3 (S3) AI Automation Team on regional automation opportunities
• Identify and implement efficiency improvements with measurable regional impact

 Supervision & Autonomy
 • Works under minimal direction with high degree of autonomy
• Works independently on technical matters
• Expected to remain hands-on
• Determines and pursues courses of action essential to achieving regional and corporate objectives
• Provides consultative guidance to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership

 What You'll Need

 Successful candidates will have extensive experience in multiple of the following areas:

 • Incident Handling: expert-level experience leading and managing complex incident response investigations, including the ability to take ownership of high-severity, multi-host, and multi-customer incidents from triage through remediation. Proven experience investigating host/user compromises, organized crime groups, and sophisticated nation-state adversaries.
• Threat Landscape Awareness: deep expertise in attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with advanced proficiency applying and extending MITRE ATT&CK to drive detection improvements and investigation strategies.
• Computer Forensic Analysis: advanced experience conducting forensic analysis across host, memory, and network artifacts using a broad toolkit to determine full scope and root cause of compromise.
• Malware Analysis: advanced ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis, including reverse engineering concepts and behavioral analysis.
• Operating System Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of Windows, Mac, and/or Linux operating systems, with particular depth in at least one of these areas.
• Systems Administration: advanced experience administering and securing enterprise network environments, with strong knowledge of IT architecture, authentication systems, and common attack paths across infrastructure.
• Network Analysis Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of network protocols and traffic analysis, with the ability to identify attack patterns, lateral movement, and exfiltration in network data.
• Identity Platform Awareness: deep expertise with identity and access management platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory, including advanced knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and credential abuse patterns.
• Email Security Awareness: advanced experience investigating and remediating Microsoft 365 security incidents, including sophisticated business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attack chains.
• Third-Party Log Analysis: advanced proficiency querying and correlating log sources across cloud platforms, network devices, identity providers, and email platforms within a SIEM environment to build detection logic and drive complex investigations.
• Incident Remediation: proven expertise developing and executing strategic and surgical remediation plans for compromised environments, including complex multi-host and multi-platform scenarios with third-party containment coordination.
• Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: expert-level understanding of secure network architecture with advanced hands-on experience navigating and troubleshooting enterprise network environments to support complex incident investigations.
• Programming/Scripting: experience developing scripts and automation using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to build investigative tooling, automate remediation workflows, and expand detection and response capabilities.
• AI Platforms: Experience working across various AI models, platforms, and tooling including MCP servers and agentic frameworks. Applies AI broadly across security operations — from investigation acceleration and workflow automation to internal capability development, prompt engineering, and driving AI adoption and maturity across the team.
• Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

 Education:
 BA or BS / MA or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related field. Applicants without a degree but with relevant work experience and/or training will be considered.

title: Senior Manager, Global Benefits
description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Senior Manager, Global Benefits

We’re ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows.

The role

Location: EMEA - Remote · Reports to: Global Total Rewards Lead

You’ll own Dataiku’s global benefits programs across all countries where we operate. The goal: benefits that help us win AI talent, feel consistent and fair wherever people work, meet local requirements, and stay financially sustainable.

Our People function is lean and decentralized. You’ll set benefits strategy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, partner directly with Finance, Legal, Payroll and our brokers, lead day-to-day benefits operations, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you’ll challenge how benefits work today and use AI to make them simpler to run and easier for employees to use.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the strategy. Define and evolve our global benefits philosophy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, balancing market competitiveness, consistency across countries and cost discipline.
  • Own the global portfolio. Design and manage health, retirement, insurance, leave and wellbeing programs across our entities and EOR countries, setting a clear global floor with smart local variation.
  • Run renewals and vendors. Lead annual renewals, broker and carrier relationships, and RFPs. Negotiate on data, not habit, and hold vendors to clear service levels.
  • Keep us compliant. Make sure plans meet local rules in every country. You’ll own US compliance directly (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500) as well as statutory and collective-agreement obligations in Europe and beyond.
  • Manage cost. Own the global benefits budget and forecasts with Finance. Model plan changes, track claims and utilization trends, and bring clear trade-offs to decision-makers.
  • Lead benefits operations. Lead the team that runs enrollment, life events, leaves, payroll and HRIS integrations, and EOR coordination. Build processes that scale without adding headcount.
  • Use AI to reinvent the experience. Automate enrollment, eligibility checks, reconciliations and employee questions with AI agents and workflows. Make it easy for employees to understand and use what we offer.
  • Support growth and change. Set up benefits for new countries, entity conversions from EOR, and acquisitions, with clean harmonization plans.
  • Communicate clearly. Build benefits guides, open-enrollment campaigns and manager resources that people actually read.

What we’re looking for

  • Extensive global benefits experience in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company.
  • Deep expertise in benefits design, renewals, vendor/broker management and benchmarking across multiple countries.
  • Strong, hands-on US benefits compliance experience, plus experience with European programs and statutory requirements, including UK and French benefits and pensions.
  • Experience managing benefits through both owned entities and Employer of Record providers (e.g. Deel, Remote).
  • A track record of building or transforming benefits programs, not just administering them.
  • Experience leading a team and influencing senior stakeholders in lean, fast-moving environments.
  • Strong analytical skills for cost modeling and claims analysis, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus).

Why join us

  • Real impact: shape benefits for a global AI company helping the world’s largest enterprises make AI work.
  • Ownership: the autonomy to build, with direct access to Total Rewards, Finance and People leadership.
  • Growth: help reinvent how People programs are delivered, with AI-powered workflows.

title: Head of NwPS Engineering
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Job Title: Head of NwPS Engineering

Location: Global / Remote (preference for US, UK, or Spain)

About the Role

The Head of NwPS Engineering is a senior VP-level leadership role responsible for the full engineering delivery and technical strategy of Vonage’s Network Powered Solutions business. This is not a delivery management role — it is an engineering leadership role that carries end-to-end accountability for the platform powering Vonage’s fastest-growing business unit.

NwPS is Vonage’s strategic growth engine, commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs — including Verify, Silent Authentication, SIM Swap, Number Verification, and Quality on Demand — for enterprise customers across FinTech, Healthcare, Transportation, and beyond. The engineering function that supports it spans multiple squads, complex multi-CSP integrations, a rapidly evolving product portfolio, and an emerging AI and agentic engineering capability.

The Head of NwPS Engineering will own the vision, structure, and execution of this engineering function. They will report directly to the SA NwPS General Manager and serve as a key voice on the NwPS leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Delivery

  • Full engineering accountability for: Verify, VNA (Vonage Network APIs), Connectors, Intelligence Engine, Advanced NwPS, and future NwPS products
  • Ownership of all NwPS squad delivery across Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, and Verify
  • QA Excellence and SDET capability across NwPS engineering
  • DevRel engineering in support of the NwPS developer ecosystem
  • Operational Excellence, SRE practices, and platform reliability

Architecture

  • End-to-end architectural accountability for NwPS engineering
  • Direct leadership of the NwPS Architecture function (Architecture Lead reports to this role)
  • Ownership of architectural standards, technical design governance, and domain architecture across NwPS products
  • Technical decision-making authority for platform design, CSP integration patterns, and engineering standards

Strategic Engineering Leadership

  • Agentic AI and MCP engineering strategy and execution
  • Engineering roadmap aligned with NwPS product strategy and commercial OKRs
  • Representation on the SA NwPS leadership team alongside NwPS Product, Solution Sales, and Strategic BD
  • Cross-functional partnership with CTO, Architecture, and SA CPaaS Engineering on shared platform standards and practices

Reporting Structure

This role leads the NwPS Architecture Lead and the squad leads for Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, Verify, and SDET Improvements.

The engineering organisation comprises approximately 40+ engineers across the squads, with seven direct reports once the Architecture Lead position is filled.

Qualifications and Experience

Engineering Vision and Strategy

  • Demonstrated ability to set and communicate a multi-year engineering vision for a complex, API-native product portfolio
  • Experience leading engineering for developer-facing or telco/network API products is strongly preferred
  • Proven capability to align engineering strategy with product roadmap and commercial priorities — not just execute against them

Leadership at Scale

  • Track record of leading distributed, multi-squad engineering organisations across multiple geographies
  • Ability to develop and retain engineering talent at all levels, including squad leads and senior engineers
  • Experience managing engineering through periods of significant growth and structural change

Technical Depth

  • Strong grounding in API platform architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering
  • Familiarity with CSP/telco network API standards (CAMARA, GSMA) is a significant advantage
  • Hands-on architecture experience sufficient to provide meaningful technical guidance to the Architecture function

Execution and Accountability

  • History of delivering complex, multi-CSP or multi-partner integrations on aggressive timelines
  • Operational rigour: reliability, KTLO management, cycle time, and quality engineering are active leadership priorities, not delegated concerns

Why This Role Matters

NwPS is building the infrastructure for a market that is still being defined. Carrier-grade, developer-accessible network APIs are emerging as a category, and Vonage is positioned to lead it. The Head of NwPS Engineering will be the person who ensures the engineering organisation is built to move fast, scale reliably, and stay ahead of a rapidly evolving technical landscape.

This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not manage something that already exists.

About Vonage and SA NwPS

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader, part of the Ericsson group. The NwPS Solution Area is Vonage’s dedicated business unit for Network Powered Solutions — commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs for enterprise customers globally. NwPS operates as a standalone business with its own P&L accountability, product roadmap, sales motion, and engineering function.

US Pay Transparency

$263,103—$346,000 USD

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The team

The Hardware Automation team builds the internal platforms and tooling that power how Nebius operates its data center infrastructure at scale. Our mission is to eliminate manual effort, reduce human error, and give every team in the Hardware Infrastructure department real-time visibility and control over the systems they own.

We operate as a product engineering team embedded within hardware infrastructure — meaning we don't just write requirements and hand them off. We own the full stack: from requirements gathering with data center operations and hardware engineering, through design and build, all the way to rollout and ongoing reliability.

The Role

Nebius is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Hardware Infrastructure Observability team. You're welcome to work from our office in Amsterdam. title: AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract)
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About Nebius Academy and Nebius Science

Nebius Academy is Nebius’s education and research initiative. It offers advanced programs in machine learning and generative AI, supports academic research through cloud grants, and works with universities and research institutions around the world.

Nebius Science is the research media lab within Nebius Academy. We cover AI research, AI-driven science, and the people and ideas shaping both fields.

Since launching in 2026, Nebius Science has highlighted the work of our researchers, covered major AI conferences and emerging research trends, and developed joint editorial projects with recipients of Nebius research grants.

Our work spans original features, technical explainers, weekly Paper Picks, research webinars, the Nebius Science Paper Club, and interviews with leading researchers.

Our goal is to make serious research accessible without flattening its complexity, and to create a meeting point for researchers, engineers, and the wider scientific community.

The role

Nebius Science is looking for an AI Science Writer based in the EU. This is an ongoing contract role with a fixed monthly retainer and opportunities for growth, including the potential to transition to a full-time position at Nebius.

You may be an AI/ML researcher or engineer who moved into journalism, a computer science graduate with substantial editorial experience, or a technical writer who has worked directly with research teams. Whatever your path, you should be able to read a technical paper, understand the underlying method, assess its limitations, and turn it into a clear and compelling story.

A central part of the role will be producing weekly reviews of new AI models, architectures, and in-house research. You should be able to identify what is genuinely new and explain how it works creatively across a range of formats.

These reviews can be visual as well as written. You will be expected to develop clear, engaging infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements, creating them yourself by using AI tools where appropriate or working with designers and multimedia producers.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Produce scientific and technical reviews of new AI models, architectures, papers, in-house research and trends.
  • Turn model architectures and complex technical ideas into clear visual narratives by developing infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia components for your stories.
  • Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders.
  • Cover major research conferences, emerging fields, and important debates across the AI ecosystem.
  • Write and edit across formats, including analytical reports, features, interviews, explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social content.
  • Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera formats.
  • Work with researchers to verify technical claims while preserving a clear editorial voice.
  • Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual stories.
  • Experiment with models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, and visual-production workflows.

We expect you to have:

  • Have professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Have a degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • Be comfortable reading papers, inspecting model architectures, comparing results, and discussing technical details directly with researchers.
  • Have strong visual instincts and be able to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, or other multimedia formats.
  • Write with precision and flair, using LLMs to support your work, not to do the writing for you.

• Track, analyze, and report on partner performance metrics, including bookings, pipeline coverage, win rates, and enablement progress, to senior leadership.

• Coordinate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product, customer success, and finance to resolve partner issues and escalations quickly and professionally.

• Share market insights, partner feedback, and competitive intelligence to inform Smartsheet's channel strategy, programs, and product direction.

 You Have

• 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales, channel, or partnerships experience, with at least 4+ years managing channel partners such as VARs, distributors, and resellers.

• A proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue quotas through partner-led and co-sell motions.

• Hands-on experience managing professional services partners, reseller or distributor relationships.

• Working knowledge of channel programs and mechanics, including deal registration, partner quoting and pricing, rebates and incentives, MDF, and partner enablement pathways.

• Familiarity with public sector and enterprise procurement, including contract vehicles and cloud marketplace transactions (for example, AWS Marketplace Private Offers).

• Strong executive presence and the ability to build credibility and trust with partner leadership and sellers alike.

• Exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to align and influence sales, marketing, sales operations, product, and customer success teams.

• Strong analytical and business acumen, with proficiency in Salesforce.com CRM and Google Suite and comfort with data-driven decision making.

• Excellent planning, forecasting, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners and priorities in parallel.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate compelling partner value propositions.

• A consultative approach and a genuine interest in understanding and solving partner business challenges.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly, approximately 25% of the time, as an essential function of the role. You will be expected to be on-site at partner offices for QBRs, planning sessions, and sales team engagements, and to attend customer events, partner conferences, and industry events across the Americas.

 At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

 Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

 About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

 The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

 The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

 This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

 On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.

• Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.

• HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.

• Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.

• PBP, ER & Programs Support.

• PBP Partnership & Employee Relations Support. Partners with the assigned People Business Partner through weekly syncs, sharing context so they have full visibility without having to ask. Supports ER cases under PBP direction by maintaining documentation and the ER tracker, coordinating investigation logistics, and preparing PIP and termination paperwork.

• Program administration: Project manages the promotion process for the assigned business function, tracking and documenting each promotion through processing. Supports compensation cycle execution and submits roles for compensation analysis, following up with leaders and tracking turnaround.

• Survey, QBR & Talent Support. Manages the engagement survey in the system and compiles data and pre-reads for leadership reviews. Supports the QBR process and prepares data and insights for talent calibration conversations.

• Reporting, Analytics & Compliance Support. Fulfills data requests and runs standard reports and headcount reconciliations, providing analysis that supports business reviews and People programs. Supports audits, country-specific filings, I-9 compliance, record retention, and policy acknowledgments, and manages vendor invoices.

• Process Improvement. Establishes and maintains SOPs so the team delivers consistent service across pods. Flags recurring case themes and tests HRIS and workflow changes, turning patterns from the assigned business function into improvements for the whole team.

• Country Expertise. Serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing knowledge of local employment practices and compliance requirements, along with language and time zone coverage. Reviews country-specific documents prepared by other coordinators, supports local filings and vendor relationships, and keeps the team current on changes in local requirements.

 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 We are looking for a service-minded, detail-obsessed People professional who takes pride in getting the work right the first time. You understand that every offer letter, record update, and employee question is someone’s experience of the company, and you treat each one that way. You are comfortable being the first point of contact for employees and managers, and you know when to resolve a request yourself and when to bring in a People Business Partner or specialist. You handle confidential information with discretion and communicate clearly in writing. You are equally at home working through a high volume of transactions and spotting the pattern behind them, and you bring ideas back that make the whole team better. You enjoy partnering with business leaders, adapt easily across time zones and cultures, and want to build toward a career as a People Business Partner or in People Operations leadership.
