title: MSP Mac Help Desk Guru (work from home)
description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com

 URL: https://ignitionit.com

 Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first

 TL;DR

 ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.

 We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.

 What the actual job???

 Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”

 You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.

 In a typical week, you might:

•
 Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.

•
 Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.

•
 Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.

•
 Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.

•
 Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."

 ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.

 About ignitionit.com

 We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!

 What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.

 We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

 If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance.

 The tech you'll work with (and grow into)

 Day one, you'll be living in:

•
 Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more)

•
 Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows

•
 Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles

•
 Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends)

•
 Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client

•
 The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling

 ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open.

 Who we hope you are

 The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you:

•
 Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both)

•
 Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband

•
 Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem

•
 Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job.

 ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who:

•
 Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people

•
 Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time

•
 Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it

•
 Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line

•
 Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former

•
 Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine)

•
 Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application)

•
 Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously

 Regarding AI

 Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive.

 Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you.

 Compensation & logistics

•
 Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk.

•
 Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones.

•
 Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet.

 How to apply

 The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how:

•
 Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works.

•
 If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items.

•
 From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment.

 If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different?

 Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you!

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-msp-mac-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

CORE Education Trust is a values-driven multi-academy trust rich in cultural and social diversity. Responsible for four academies in Birmingham, the Trust was set up to innovate through adversity and to challenge the conventional boundaries of what is possible for our students. Motivated and inspired by the success of our students, our ambition goes beyond textbooks and whiteboards, we are proud to work with the young people of Birmingham.

This role will be based at City Academy which is an 11-16 co-educational school. You will be joining an academy team whose sole aim is to ensure that all students get the very best support, care and guidance that enables them to achieve their very best.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Our school is a place of possibility and we never underestimate the impact inspirational staff can have on the life chances of our students. We are seeking a dynamic Head of Business & Computer Studieswho can demonstrate their commitment to driving up standards, expectations, and aspirations, so that staff and students regularly experience success and a sense of progression, whilst acting as a role model for staff within the department.

This is an exciting time to join the trust. We have a well-established outward facing ethos as a forward thinking family of schools guided by a vision underpinned by optimism, ambition and oneness.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION & HOW TO APPLY

For further information about this exciting opportunity, or an informal discussion please contact Recruitment via recruitment@CORE-education.co.uk.

Founded in 2012, Excalibur Academies Trust has grown from two schools in Marlborough, Wiltshire, to 20 schools reaching from Bristol to Reading along the M4 corridor, providing high-quality education to 10,000 children from 9 months to age 18.

Our vision is to provide an all-through education in local hubs, with a focus on the best teaching, a broad and exciting curriculum and an outward-facing global perspective. We believe in investing in our staff to ensure we attract and retain talented, dedicated people who are committed to changing children’s lives for the better.

With a strong track record of raising the achievement of disadvantaged pupils across the trust, it is our mission to promote social mobility and personal fulfilment through the transformative power of education. Our growth strategy is based on our hub model and building the capacity to provide strong support and opportunities to other schools who share our vision.

The Role

title: RLT Fundraising Officer
description:
This is a hands-on role where you will have the opportunity to build your fundraising experience and make a

real contribution to the River Learning Trust’s (RLT) ability to increase funding for key educational priorities

and initiatives. You will also be helping to build the culture of philanthropy across the RLT community,

managing resources, administration, and communications across the network.

You will be pivotal in researching and applying for funding from grant-making bodies, and also supporting

the freelance fundraising consultant to build meaningful relationships with potential donors, local

businesses, and other stakeholder groups.

You will also be responsible for managing the day-to-day running and support of the Trust-wide CRM

fundraising database, Beacon, ensuring best practice, alongside developing, and supporting the user base

across the school network.

Working with our freelance fundraising consultant, and reporting into the Trust’s CFO, the medium- to long-

term goal is to ensure that the Trust continues to build a strong and dynamic fundraising community,

alongside increasing the amount of philanthropic income used to support important areas of educational

need.

What skills / experience are required

We’re looking for someone with at least one year’s experience in a fundraising role who is organised,

enthusiastic, and confident building relationships. We need someone who can work independently,

proactively, and to a high standard, but also enjoys working collaboratively with the rest of the team and

wider staff network. You need to understand and be demonstrably competent using a CRM database, and

other relevant software, as well as writing clear and engaging funding applications and communications.

What we can offer

You will have the opportunity to build your fundraising knowledge and skill-set, in a casual, yet supportive

environment, working alongside our experienced fundraising consultant, and other established fundraising

professionals across the network. The post-holder will be expected to develop and drive several important

projects over the medium- to long-term, and do so by working flexibly across the week, during term time.

Education has the power to change lives, communities, and society for the better. At RLT we believe that we

can achieve more for our pupils, trainees, staff, and communities by working together rather than alone.

Schools in RLT are united by a common belief in the benefits of working together, and by our commitment to

shared principles.

OUR VISION is for our schools and SCITT to improve rapidly, continuously, and sustainably: to be better

faster together.

OUR ‘WHY?’ is that children and young people ‘only get one go’ in school and therefore as part of RLT we

aim to ensure the best possible ‘go’ for our pupils.

OUR ‘HOW?’ is through the highest support and challenge for our schools and each other, underpinned by

our principles.

Our employees benefit from a wide variety of support including extensive continuing professional learning

and development opportunities, wellbeing and staff networks and access to Defined Benefit Pension

Schemes (TPS and LGPS) for all staff. ,For more information on what it is like to work for the Trust, and the

benefits you could access, please see our “Working in RLT” guide.

This role includes regulated activity relevant to children.

If you would like to have a confidential chat with Ali James about the role, prior to application, then please

email: ajames@riverlearningtrust.org, to arrange a call.

The River Learning Trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all children and

preventing extremism. The Trust is required to conduct a variety of checks and online searches about you

as part of their recruitment process in accordance with Keeping Children Safe in Education guidance. It is an

offence to apply for certain roles within schools if you are barred from engaging in regulated activity relevant

to children. The River Learning Trust is an equal opportunities employer committed to creating a safe,

inclusive environment for all staff, free from discrimination and harassment.

Leeds Conservatoire is seeking an exceptional academic leader, educator and creative practitioner to join our senior leadership team as Deputy Head of School of Music.

  • Supporting and developing academic teams through effective leadership and collaboration.
  • Building relationships with schools, industry partners, professional bodies and the wider education sector.
  • Contributing to student recruitment, external engagement and institutional initiatives.

About You

We are looking for an ambitious and forward-thinking academic leader with a passion for music education and curriculum innovation with:

  • Significant experience within higher education, conservatoire education or a related educational setting.
  • A strong understanding of music performance, composition, production and/or music education.
  • Experience of curriculum design, validation and programme development.
  • A track record of leading academic teams and managing change.
  • Knowledge of quality assurance and regulatory requirements within higher education.
  • A commitment to inclusive education, student success and educational excellence.
  • The vision and creativity to develop new opportunities that respond to the evolving music and education sectors.

About the Role

Part Time - 22.5 hours per week

We are seeking a dedicated Safeguarding Officer (known as a Stay Safe Officer within the Group) to join BCC’s Student Life team, working across our campuses to ensure effective safeguarding arrangements are in place for students and vulnerable adults.

Working closely with curriculum teams and colleagues across the College, you will respond to safeguarding concerns, help minimise risks and promote student welfare, mental health and wellbeing. Taking a restorative, student-centred approach, you will help create a safe and supportive environment where students and staff feel confident to raise concerns.

You will play a key role in maintaining our strong safeguarding culture and building on the outstanding judgement for personal development in our latest Ofsted inspection. If you are passionate about protecting and supporting young people and vulnerable adults, we would love to hear from you.

Our campuses are easily accessible by public transport.

What You Will Do

  • Manage a caseload of students where there is a safeguarding concern.
  • Build effective and supportive relationships with vulnerable learners.
  • Record all work accurately and in a timely manner on the CPOMS system.
  • Provide supervision to designated safeguarding officers in curriculum departments.
  • Monitor and review support for vulnerable students providing, expertise and information as required.
  • Plan and deliver staff training on a range of different safeguarding topics.
  • Monitor the recording and reporting of safeguarding referrals on campus, using appropriate client record and MIS systems, ensuring processes are followed.
  • Act as a point of contact for external agencies and attend external meetings as required.
  • Lead and contribute to cross college campaigns on a range of different safeguarding topics working closely with curriculum teams, the marketing team and student union.

About You

  • Level 2 Safeguarding trained.
  • A recognised qualification in at least one area of expertise in safeguarding, health and care to a minimum of NVQ 3 or equivalent, or substantial experience.
  • Recent experience working as a designated safeguarding officer.
  • Experience of working with vulnerable groups in an educational setting.
  • Up to date knowledge and experience of a range of safeguarding issues.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, a good listener who is non-judgemental and able to be adaptable to the needs of staff and students.

title: Student Welfare Officer
location: Leeds, Yorkshire and the Humber, GB
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a dedicated and compassionate Student Welfare Officer to join our team at Leeds City College in the Adult & Community department. In this role, you will provide essential advice, guidance and practical support to students experiencing financial hardship, housing difficulties and other welfare challenges that may affect their ability to access and succeed in education.

You will manage applications for financial assistance through the Learning Support Fund, support students with complex welfare needs, and work closely with curriculum, pastoral and SEND teams to ensure appropriate support is in place. You will also develop and deliver welfare awareness activities, build relationships with external support agencies, and monitor the impact of interventions on student attendance, achievement and progression. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference to students' lives by helping them overcome barriers to learning and achieve their potential.

What You Will Do

  • Provide welfare advice and practical support to students facing financial, housing and personal difficulties.

  • Manage the Learning Support Fund, including applications for travel, meals and equipment.

  • Support vulnerable students and manage complex welfare cases.

  • Work with pastoral, curriculum and SEND teams to remove barriers to learning.

  • Refer students to external agencies and specialist support services.

  • Deliver welfare awareness activities and information sessions.

  • Monitor student attendance, progress and the impact of welfare interventions.

  • Maintain accurate records and promote student wellbeing, safeguarding and inclusion.

About You

We are looking for someone who is compassionate, approachable and committed to helping students overcome barriers to education. You will have:

  • Level 2 qualifications in English and maths.

  • A degree or equivalent higher-level qualification, or a relevant professional qualification with substantial experience.

  • A Level 4 qualification in advice or support work, such as Information, Advice and Guidance (IAG), or substantial experience in providing advice.

  • Significant experience supporting vulnerable students, including SEND learners and those experiencing financial hardship.

  • Strong knowledge of student finance, funding, welfare support and barriers to learning.

  • Experience working with external agencies and referring individuals to specialist services.

  • Excellent communication, listening and interpersonal skills, with an empathetic and non-judgemental approach.

  • Strong organisational and IT skills, including managing caseloads, maintaining records and monitoring interventions.

  • A commitment to safeguarding, equality, diversity, inclusion and restorative practice.

title: Cleaner
description:
We are recruiting a school cleaner to join our professional site team. We are looking for a reliable and conscientious colleague, who will take pride in the appearance of the school and provide a clean and tidy environment for our students, staff and lettings.

Experience in school cleaning is useful but not essential and using cleaning machines and cleaning products would be an advantage, although training will be provided for the successful applicant. Common sense and the ability to be self-motivated is essential. You will need to work as part of a team under the direction of the Cleaning Manager.

Working hours are 15:15 -18:30, Monday to Friday, total 16.25 hours per week.

Working as part of our dedicated team, duties will include vacuuming, polishing, emptying bins, toilet cleaning etc. You must be able to use your own initiative and be motivated to work in an educational setting with children. Experience is desirable but full training will be given.

Specific Duties

  1. To undertake as required appropriate training in the use of equipment and chemicals used.
  2. Provide a comprehensive cleaning service to include dusting, vacuuming, washing floors, emptying bins etc. to ensure high standards of cleanliness and hygiene at all times.
  3. Removal of graffiti from reach heights daily as required.
  4. Wiping of skirting boards and walls daily.
  5. Collection and disposal of rubbish to designated areas.
  6. Maintain clean toilets to ensure hygiene standards are met. Mop floors daily.
  7. Ensure grounds are kept free from rubbish and debris so a clean and tidy site is maintained at all times.
  8. To replenish hand towels, hand soap and toilet roll as required.
  9. Report any premises or equipment defects to a senior caretaker.
  10. Undertake, if working during School Holiday shutdowns, a complete “deep clean” of all areas. Including window cleaning, moving furniture to clean, behind radiators, outside areas etc.

Please complete the application form to apply for the position.

In addition to providing the highest standards of teaching and learning, the priority of the Academy is the safety and welfare of its students. Therefore all staff undergo an enhanced DBS investigation and full references will be taken.

title: Director, Partner Operations
description:
Headquarters: USA - Remote

 About Ping Identity:

 At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

 Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

 While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

 We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

 Position Summary

 As the Director of Partner Operations, you will lead the operational engine that powers our global partner ecosystem. You will be responsible for building and optimizing processes, tools, and programs that support all partner types—resell, referral, delivery, technology, MSP, and cloud marketplaces.

 You will collaborate closely with Sales Operations, Channel Sales, Alliances, Product, Finance, and Marketing to ensure our partner strategy is supported by scalable infrastructure and clear performance metrics.

 Please note: while this is a remote role, we are seeking candidates based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to support close collaboration with our West Coast channel leadership.

 Key Responsibilities

• Partner Operations Strategy

• Lead the development and execution of partner operations strategy aligned to business growth goals.

• Design and implement scalable processes to support a diverse partner ecosystem, including resellers, referral partners, GSIs, SIs, MSPs, ISVs, and cloud marketplaces (e.g., AWS, Azure).

• Build dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure partner performance, pipeline, and influence.

• Sales Operations Alignment

• Partner with Sales Ops and RevOps to integrate partner data into core sales systems (Salesforce, PRM, BI tools).

• Optimize lead-to-cash processes for indirect routes, including partner deal registration, attribution, and compensation.

• Partner Program & Enablement

• Support ongoing evolution of Ping’s partner program, tiers, incentives, and benefits.

• Ensure operational support for onboarding, certification, and enablement workflows.

• Track partner participation and compliance with program requirements.

• Technology & Systems Ownership

• Own or influence tools that support partner lifecycle (e.g., PRM, Salesforce, LMS, partner portals).

• Work with IT and vendors to enhance partner system capabilities and integrations.

• Cross-functional Leadership

• Serve as the key operations point of contact for Partner Sales, Alliances, and Executive Leadership.

• Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to support GTM alignment with technology and cloud partners.

title: Engineering Manager, Knowledge Graph Platform
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Who We Are:

 The Knowledge Graph Platform team builds the foundational systems that help Reddit understand entities, relationships, and context across its content. We are evolving an advanced, AI-powered knowledge graph into a reliable, scalable platform that enables teams across Reddit to build better experiences on top of shared, high-quality knowledge.

 This is a high-leverage team at the intersection of data, platform engineering, and AI. Our work supports emerging capabilities such as contextual grounding while creating the contracts, standards, and developer experience that make shared data dependable and easy to use. This team is strategically positioned to impact both ads and consumer roadmaps. Our data is used across ads marketplace models as well as user-facing features on reddit.com .

 What You’ll Do:

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers building Reddit’s Knowledge Graph Platform; create a high-trust, high-performing environment with clear goals and strong technical ownership.

• Set the technical direction and roadmap for a scalable knowledge graph platform, including data and API contracts, service interfaces, reliability, observability, performance, and developer experience.

• Leverage SOTA LLM and agentic patterns for knowledge graph construction.

• Establish production-grade operating standards: defining SLOs, implementing quality measures of data within the knowledge graph, governance mechanisms, and safe change-management practices.

• Partner with engineering, computational linguists, and domain-expert teams to define a shared operating model for ontology, data quality, governance, and platform evolution.

• Be a steward of data in the KG - ensure the graph has the coverage and freshness needed for priority use cases. Work with our dedicated data labeler team on shared goals around data coverage and quality.

• Work closely with internal product and engineering teams to understand their needs, prioritize high-value use cases, and increase access to the platform.

• Drive the next wave of graph-powered capabilities, including opportunities in shopping, search, ads marketplace models, consumer feed models.

• Stay close to architecture and technical design, helping the team navigate complex system tradeoffs and contribute hands-on when it is the highest-leverage path.

• Communicate the team’s strategy, priorities, risks, and progress clearly across a distributed, cross-functional organization.

 Who You Might Be:

• 8+ years of total software engineering experience, with 2+ years directly managing, coaching, and developing engineering teams.

• Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic or ontology systems, entity resolution, search, or contextual grounding is highly desired.

• Experience building or operating AI/ML powered, or data-intensive platforms, with a proven track record of leading shared technical systems with multiple internal customers.

• Strong understanding of how to turn a technical system into a product-like platform: setting an operating model with customers, establishing data or service-level contracts, useful documentation, and a path to self-service adoption.

• Experience establishing data contracts around quality, lineage, or governance.

• Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, backend services, data platforms, APIs, reliability, and operational excellence.

• Comfortable making technical and product tradeoffs in ambiguity, including when a dedicated product manager is not present.

• Excellent collaborator and communicator who can earn trust with engineers, senior leaders, and partner teams across time zones.

• Enjoy building clarity and durable operating mechanisms where ownership and processes are still evolving. Excel in evangelization and driving platform adoption cross org.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

 Nice to Have:

• Master’s or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.

 Location:

 This role is 100% remote (US & Canada only) and will regularly meet with teams in the EU and the US. Candidates based in ET timezone will be given preference to accommodate team schedules.

title: Salesforce Lead - USA
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 Storyblok is hiring a Salesforce Lead to own Salesforce architecture, execution, governance, data quality, integrations, and release discipline across our GTM workflows. This techno-functional owner moves from business process to system design, build coordination, release control, data quality, reporting impact, and user adoption, owning Sales Cloud and core CRM objects, Pardot / Account Engagement, DealHub CPQ integration, lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash workflows, routing, campaign and lifecycle data, permissions, integrations, and documentation. The role also leads future platform evaluation for Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs, and, if a platform is selected, leads implementation planning and execution with RevOps, Marketing Operations, Data, Finance, Legal, vendors, and external partners.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Salesforce architecture and GTM systems governance

• Own Salesforce platform architecture across GTM workflows, objects, fields, permissions, automations, integrations, and release control.

• Translate RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Data requirements into clean system design and controlled execution.

• Maintain governance for new fields, objects, flows, validation rules, permission sets, integrations, reporting dependencies, and documentation.

• Sales Cloud and core CRM ownership

• Own system design for leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, activities, campaigns, lifecycle stages, routing, renewals, expansions, and customer handoffs.

• Support lead-to-cash workflows with clear ownership, required fields, source logic, stage rules, assignment logic, and adoption checks.

• Monitor CRM completeness, data freshness, duplicates, routing failures, and workflow friction that creates manual workarounds.

• Pardot, Account Engagement, and marketing workflow support

• Partner with Marketing Operations on Pardot or Account Engagement, campaign data, lifecycle stages, scoring inputs, consent, routing, attribution support, and funnel reporting.

• Maintain the Salesforce-side architecture for marketing-to-sales handoffs, campaign member data, source fields, conversion logic, and reporting quality.

• Keep current marketing workflows stable while future marketing cloud and CDP options are evaluated.

• Future Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle, and CDP evaluation

• Lead the requirements, scorecard, architecture review, vendor comparison, data governance review, and implementation readiness plan for future customer data and marketing cloud decisions.

• Evaluate Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs against GTM use cases, data model, activation, consent, reporting, integration, cost, and operating complexity.

• If a platform is selected, lead implementation planning and execution with clear phases, owners, risks, testing, migration, enablement, and adoption metrics.

• DealHub CPQ integration, data quality, releases, and adoption

• Own Salesforce-side integration quality for DealHub CPQ, including quote data, approval sync, product lines, opportunity fields, order handoffs, and reporting impact.

• Run release management with intake, solution design, testing, regression checks, deployment, communication, documentation, and adoption tracking.

• Partner with Data on source-to-report logic so Salesforce, warehouse, Finance, and leadership reporting stay aligned.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 6+ years in the Salesforce ecosystem, including hands-on administration and solution / architecture ownership in a GTM or Revenue Operations context.

• Salesforce certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder; Sales Cloud Consultant or Application Architect a plus).

• Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, core CRM objects, declarative automation (Flow), permissions, and release / change management across environments.

• Experience with Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and marketing-to-sales workflows, and with CPQ tools (DealHub or comparable) across lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash.

• Experience integrating Salesforce with downstream systems (data warehouse, Finance, marketing, order management) and supporting reporting and data quality.

• Familiarity with CDP / marketing cloud platform evaluation (e.g., Salesforce Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle Responsys) is a plus.

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

 PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

• Systems thinking: translates cross-functional business requirements into clean, scalable system design and governance.

• Technical CRM depth: strong command of Salesforce architecture, data model, automation, permissions, and integrations.

• Release and change discipline: structured intake, testing, regression, deployment, documentation, and adoption tracking.

• Data quality and governance orientation: drives completeness, freshness, deduplication, and field control.

• Stakeholder management: partners effectively across RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, CS, Finance, Data, Legal, and vendors.

• Vendor and platform evaluation: builds requirements, scorecards, and implementation readiness plans for major platform decisions.

• Clear communication: explains what is being built, the decision needed, and the business outcome to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Bias for reliability: reduces defects, manual workarounds, and ambiguity through documentation and controlled execution.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


What We're About
 
At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around using data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.
 
The Role
 
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. The Warp Speed Deployment role centers around using data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to manufacture high-quality products is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into a reality.
 
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most exciting problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into an understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.
 
You'll immerse yourself in our customers' most intricate workflows. You'll partner with customer teams and explore the data, and plunge into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll seek will require a curious and analytical approach, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user insight to ultimately empower our customers to improve decisions.

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship - Warp Speed
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Join Salesforce in London as the regional field marketing lead for our Platform business across EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) and the UK and Ireland, including Agentforce and our security and developer services. You will own the full-funnel plan and the marketing-driven pipeline for the region, and build lasting relationships with senior security, IT and data leaders.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Set and deliver the regional field marketing strategy and quarterly plan, turning a significant program budget into measurable pipeline and revenue growth across events, digital and organic activity.
  • Design and host small, invite-only executive forums, CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) roundtables and Gartner executive summits that open doors for Agentforce and security-led deals.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, senior Sales leaders and the UK and Ireland field leader to agree on priorities, target accounts and follow-up, and report results with a clear business story.
  • Guide Field Marketing Analysts on workshops, webinars and digital programs, and manage agency and event partners, without direct line management.

You're Our Person If...

  • You have 10 or more years of marketing experience, including field marketing, with a record of owning and delivering pipeline and revenue targets.
  • You have designed and delivered high-touch, in-person executive events and engaged C-level and senior technical buyers.
  • You have built strong alignment with Product Marketing and Sales leaders and can manage a budget, quarterly plan and KPIs independently across several markets.
  • Experience will be evaluated based on alignment to the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer work, etc.)

Even Better If...

  • You have security or technology marketing experience, including CISO or Gartner executive programs.
  • You have experience with CRM, campaign management and marketing reporting tools.
  • You have mentored junior colleagues.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Principal Experience Designer - Visual Design & Design Systems
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://www.workiva.com/latam/

 Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.

 This is a dual-focus principal role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will be spent leading Unify’s visual design direction: evolving its visual language, shaping token architecture, and creating the reference designs and guidance that help teams build consistently. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. That work is not separate from the system, it’s part of the broader ecosystem of design in which Unify lives.

 You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.

 What you’ll do

• Define and evolve Unify’s visual language across typography, color, spacing, iconography, motion, and brand expression.

• Partner with the components sub-team and the patterns and templates sub-team to ensure visual design is applied consistently and intentionally across every asset.

• Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.

• Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.

• Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.

• Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.

• Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.

• Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.

• Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.

 What you’ll need

 Minimum Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in product design, visual design, UX, or related fields, including significant work on platform or enterprise products.

• Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

 Preferred Qualifications

• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and the ability to translate a visual point of view into scalable product systems.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.

• Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.

• Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.

• Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.

• A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.

• Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.

• Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.

• Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.

 Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

• Up to 20-25% travel required to meet with teams, partners, and customers

• Reliable internet connection required for remote or hybrid work environments

 How You’ll Be Rewarded

 ✅ Salary range in the US: $190,000.00 - $315,000.00

 ✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

 ✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

 ✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

 The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

 Why Join Workiva

 Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

 At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

 Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

 Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email talentacquisition@workiva.com .

 Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

 Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

title: Senior Product Designer (Webflow) Temp to Perm
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 Senior Product Designer (Webflow)

 At Current

 At Current, Senior Product Designers (Webflow) lead the design and delivery of engaging digital experiences across multiple client engagements. You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams across strategy, production, engineering, and client services to create thoughtful, user-centered websites that are both beautifully designed and expertly built in Webflow.

 Senior Product Designers are strategic, hands-on creators. You're equally comfortable conducting UX discovery, designing polished experiences in Figma, and building production-ready websites in Webflow. You own projects from concept through launch, partnering with engineering only when advanced custom development or integrations are required.

 What You'll Do

• Lead UX and visual design across websites and digital experiences for multiple client engagements

• Partner with strategy, production, engineering, and client stakeholders to define user experience and creative direction

• Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs in Figma

• Design and build responsive, production-ready websites directly in Webflow

• Develop scalable design systems, reusable components, and CMS structures in Webflow

• Translate business goals into intuitive, accessible, and conversion-focused digital experiences

• Collaborate with engineers on advanced functionality, integrations, and custom development when needed

• Optimize websites for usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and SEO

• Conduct UX reviews and recommend improvements based on best practices and user insights

• Stay current on UX trends, accessibility standards, and evolving Webflow capabilities

 What You'll Bring

• 5–7 years of UX/UI, Product, or Digital Design experience, ideally within an agency or consulting environment

• 2+ years building production-ready websites in Webflow

• Advanced proficiency with Figma and Webflow

• Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership from UX strategy through final Webflow implementation

• Experience building scalable Webflow websites using CMS Collections, Components, and design systems

• Experience with Client-First methodology, Relume, and Finsweet Attributes

• Strong understanding of UX, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and information architecture

• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS with the ability to partner effectively with engineers

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 Nice to Have

• Experience with Lottie, GSAP, or interactive animations

• Experience integrating Webflow with HubSpot, Memberstack, Airtable, Zapier, Make, or similar platforms

• Experience using analytics or A/B testing to inform design decisions

• Familiarity with Jira, Workfront, or similar project management tools

• Experience working within Agile delivery environments

 Why Current

 At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

 We're a remote-first agency with teams across the U.S., working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. title: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 About the Role

 As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

 Key Responsibilities

• Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.

• Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.

• Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.

• Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.

• QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.

• Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.

• Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.

• Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.

• Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.

• Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

 Qualifications

 Required

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.

• Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.

• Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.

• Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.

• A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.

• Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.

• Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

• Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

 Preferred

• Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.

• Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.

• Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).

• Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.

• Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

• Agency or consulting experience.

 Why Current

 At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

 We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

 You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

 This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

 About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

 We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

 Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

 Our Core Technologies

 Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

 What You'll Do

 • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

 • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

 • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

 • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

 • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

 • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

 • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

 • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

 • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

 • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

 • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

 What We Look For:

 • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

 • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

 • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

 • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

 • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

 • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

 • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

 • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

 Nice To Have:

 • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

 • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

 About the Team

 The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

 You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

 Role Description

 As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

 You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

 This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

 The impact you will have

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

• Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

• Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

 What we look for

• Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

• Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

• Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.

• Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.

• Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

 About Databricks

 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

 Benefits

 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

 Compliance

description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 About Vercel:

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

 Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

 About the Role

 We're looking for a Staff level Engineer to lead the design and development of a next-generation Data Platform at Vercel. This is a unique opportunity to architect a foundational system that will power data across our products and business, supporting everything from real-time analytics to AI/ML initiatives.

 Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data Engineering, you'll define the technical vision for our data ecosystem, work across the organization to align engineering strategy with product goals, and build scalable, reliable systems using modern technologies like Kafka, ClickHouse, Tinybird, and Snowflake.

 You'll lead from the front, writing production-grade code, setting high standards for design and data governance, and mentoring a team of engineers as the organization grows. If you're excited by the challenge of building scalable data systems that drive product innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

 What You Will Do

• Design and implement a next-generation data platform that supports diverse requirements, including batch and real-time integrations, advanced analytics, and multiple data types, leveraging Kafka, Kafka-based tooling, and additional streaming technologies to power real-time data movement and processing.

• Work with engineering, product, and senior leadership teams across Vercel to architect solutions that address business needs, aligning technical strategies with product goals and ensuring seamless data availability and usability.

• Define and maintain guidelines for data ingestion, creation, enrichment, and storage, while overseeing data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing (ClickHouse, Tinybird, Snowflake) to achieve low-latency analytics and scalable storage.

• Develop end-to-end solutions across the tech stack, setting the example for engineering excellence, and provide mentorship and direction that fosters continuous improvement and innovation in the team.

• Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure adherence to data protection standards, and champion high availability and fault tolerance through comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.

• Drive architectural decisions and roadmap planning that ensure efficiency, scalability, and high performance, and evaluate build-vs-buy trade-offs, integrating vendor solutions where appropriate.

• Collaborate with data scientists and machine learning teams to evolve infrastructure that supports advanced analytics and AI initiatives, serving as a key contributor to strategy, tooling, and platform enhancements for ML-related workloads.

• Act as a key decision-maker for discovering, vetting, and selecting data architectures and technologies critical to Vercel's success, and establish multi-phase strategic roadmaps that align with overall business objectives and drive data platform maturity.

 About You

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, with at least 5 years at the Principal Engineer level.

• Proven track record designing and operating large-scale data infrastructures at high scale in a complex, fast-paced environment, with experience across Kafka and its ecosystem (e.g., Kafka Streams, Confluent Platform), ClickHouse, Tinybird, Snowflake, and broader big data frameworks.

• Proficiency in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and associated big data services.

• Strong background in data governance and security, and adept at ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and protecting sensitive information.

• Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across varying organizational levels.

• A leadership mindset, with demonstrated ability to mentor teams, drive consensus, and advocate for best practices across the organization.

• A Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

• Industry recognition or notable contributions in data engineering (e.g., published works, open-source contributions) is a plus.
